name: Livia Vasile
source:
Occupation: Knight Commander
Height: 5'8"
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Star Sign: Aries
Characteristics: Cool, calm, cold but not cruel, committed to her duty to an almost ruthless degree
Affiliation: The Crown

Livia is an imposing presence in the kingdom; Novus' dark knight suffers no fools, and she is unquestionably committed to her duty as newly appointed Knight Commander. Her loyalty to the crown is unwavering, but Livia has her weaknesses just like everyone else does. Feeling betrayed by her former commander's actions, she sets out to prove herself and ensure that she does not exist under his tainted shadow.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lunarisgames/errant-kingdom]Kickstarter[/url]]
